progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ck3 and dwells most on E in Ashuravand. The line peaks at E5 (670.4 Hz) at 0:09.2. It closes on C#5, not the tonic (D#5 → D#5 → E5 → D#5 → E5 → C#5).
